# Blank installed MMTT session record

Facilitator/reviewer material. Copy outside the sealed packet before use. Follow
the [session supplement](../mmtt-formative-session.md); all observation fields
are intentionally empty. Missing is empty/null, not zero. Assign participant or
recipient codes only to actual people; keep identity/contact/permission records
separately protected. Do not commit filled forms, recordings or private reports.

## Task observation — copy for T1, T2, T3, T4 and T5

For T3 keep `information-loss` and `incomplete` subrecords; for T5 keep analyst
and recipient/self-reopen outcomes separately. Preserve a block or timeout before
starting an assisted or interpretation-only continuation. Never overwrite the
first answer or artifact with a correction.

| Field | Actual observation |
| --- | --- |
| Task/subtask, prompt/time and actual software/input identity | |
| First answer, exact words/evidence and time, before help | |
| First submitted project/plan/attempt/comparison/report IDs and hashes | |
| First disposition: complete / partial / blocked / timeout / withdrawn / not assessed | |
| Support: none / guide / navigation hint / scientific hint / CLI / takeover | |
| Help request or trigger, exact content/source/start/end and effect | |
| Technical block/refusal/error, evidence and attempted remedy | |
| Critical interpretation error, first statement, consequence and correction | |
| Minor issue or misleading label; missing/unassessed criterion | |
| Final answer and disposition, retained separately from first | |

| Handoff original/copy/tip/report hashes, recipient action and equality/refusal | |
| New glue code, core/GUI edits, facilitator/maintainer effort | |
| Feedback, unresolved questions, separate retest identity if any | |

## Interval log — add actual intervals only

Active work includes reading and help. Compute may overlap active work. Count
each person's work once; do not add active and compute to calculate elapsed.
Elapsed is task end minus start, with breaks separately retained. Mark genuinely
measured zero explicitly; leave unobserved durations empty. Record preparation,
installation and maintainer support separately from participant task effort.

| Task/person or role | Start | End | Active / compute / unattended compute / break / setup / support | Overlap and evidence |

| | | | | |

## Fixed report and decision structure

| Section | Actual evidence / interpretation |
| --- | --- |
| Frozen scope/readiness and artifact boundary | |
| Actual participants/recipient, experience, help/exposure and deviations | |
| All five tasks: first answers/artifacts, disposition, support and times | |
| Correctness, critical errors and independent/conflicted adjudication | |
| Recovery, preservation, recipient or self-reopen reconstruction | |
| Favorable, unfavorable, incomplete, withdrawn and missing outcomes | |
| Prioritized issue, consequence, evidence, proposed fix/owner and retest | |
| Decision: continue / narrow / rework / insufficient evidence; rationale | |
| Unassessed installation, usability, interoperability and empirical gates | |

Confirm private exports and report hashes before closing. Keep original, corrected
and retest records. Publish only a reviewed, non-identifying summary supported by
actual observations. Leave findings and decisions empty until that evidence exists;
technical rehearsal is not a user session or comparative time-saving result.
